name: Dousoukai Refrain
source:
New Year's Eve, one and a half a year after the events of Dousoukai. 
Main character gathers members of tennis club to have the end of the year party. They visit their friend's rock band "XAX" live after the banquet. The gig raises enthusiasm, and just as clock strikes 12, the first snow of the year starts, and old feelings revive in hearts. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《同窗会》事件过去一年半后的新年前夜。
主人公召集网球部成员举行忘年会。聚餐结束后，众人前去观看朋友所在的摇滚乐队“XAX”的现场演出。演出令气氛愈发热烈，时钟敲响午夜十二点时，入冬后的第一场雪也飘落下来，往日的感情重新在众人心中苏醒。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
